description: Everything around the model that makes an agent work: the loop, tools, context files, permissions, sandbox, hooks, verifiers and persistent state.
Designing and tuning the harness so agents work reliably with little supervision. An `emerging` term.
Designing systems that start, verify and re-run agents with triggers, stop rules, persistent state and escalation. An `emerging` term.
Stacking independent controls (policy, sandbox, hooks, verifiers) so one gap does not become an incident.
An agent run with no human approving each step, such as a nightly or CI-triggered job; the case this module prepares for.
The module's checkpoint: a decision record and a harness plan (permissions, sandbox, hooks, verifiers, loop) for a briefing.
